{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check unique sites
print(df['site'].unique())

# Check for duplicates in patient_id
print(f"Number of unique patient_id: {df['patient_id'].nunique()}")
print(f"Total rows: {len(df)}")
print(f"Duplicate patient_id count: {len(df) - df['patient_id'].nunique()}")

# Check for -999 in biomarker_baseline
print(f"Number of -999 in biomarker_baseline: {(df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999).sum()}")

# Check for assay_batch and units
print(f"Unique assay_batch values: {df['assay_batch'].unique()}")

# Check arm and severity association
print("\nCross-tabulation of arm vs severity:")
print(pd.crosstab(df['arm'], df['severity'], margins=True))"}
